recipes.title: Protein French Toast Cloud

items.i: light Greek yogurt (plain or vanilla, about 2 cups)

steps: Whisk the yogurt, eggs and cornflour until smooth.
Pour into a parchment-lined loaf pan and bake at 200 °C (about 400 °F) for around 45 minutes until puffed and deep golden — keep an eye on it, every oven differs.
Slice into 8, drizzle with sugar-free caramel and dust with powdered sugar.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros (whole recipe 661 cal, 66 g protein) are from the video description; per-slice macros include the caramel topping. The video voiceover says 350 °F for about an hour instead — both work, just watch the colour.
